```
507.   | "driveName"
508.   | "driveEfficiency"
509.   | "reactorEfficiency"
510.   | "tanks"
511.   | "driveMass"
512.   | "fuelMass"
513.   | "reactorMass"
514.   | "radiatorMass"
515.   | "totalTons"
516.   | "totalCost"
517.   | "deltaV"
518.   | "acceleration"
519.   | "travelDays";
520. 
521. interface CalcParams {
522.   dryMassTons: number;
523.   radiatorDataName: string;
524.   targetDeltaVKps: number;
525.   targetDistanceAU: number;
526. }
527. 
528. function computeCalcRow(
529.   drive: Analysis["drives"][0],
530.   radiator: Analysis["radiators"][0] | undefined,
531.   params: CalcParams,
532. ) {
533.   if (drive.reactorTons === undefined) return null;
534. 
535.   const needsRadiator = drive.cooling === "Calc" || drive.cooling === "Closed";
536.   const radiatorTons = needsRadiator && radiator ? (drive.wasteHeatGW || 0) / radiator.gwPerTon : 0;
537. 
538.   const fixedMassTons = params.dryMassTons + (drive.reactorTons || 0) + radiatorTons;
539. 
540.   const EV_ms = drive.EV_kps * 1000;
541.   const targetDV_ms = params.targetDeltaVKps * 1000;
542.   const massRatio = Math.exp(targetDV_ms / EV_ms);
543.   const requiredFuelMassTons = fixedMassTons * (massRatio - 1);
544.   const requiredTanks = Math.ceil(requiredFuelMassTons / 100);
545.   if (requiredTanks > 1000) return null; // can't reach target deltaV within 1000-tank limit
546.   const tanksNeeded = Math.max(1, requiredTanks);
547. 
548.   const fuelMassTons = tanksNeeded * 100;
549.   const totalMassTons = fixedMassTons + fuelMassTons;
550. 
551.   const actualDeltaVMs = EV_ms * Math.log(totalMassTons / fixedMassTons);
552.   const actualDeltaVKps = actualDeltaVMs / 1000;
553. 
554.   const totalMassKg = totalMassTons * 1000;
555.   const accelerationMs2 = drive.thrust_N / totalMassKg;
556.   const accelerationMilliGs = (accelerationMs2 / 9.81) * 1000;
557. 
558.   const targetDistanceM = params.targetDistanceAU * 149597870700;
559.   const midpointDistance = targetDistanceM / 2;
560.   const avgMassKg = ((totalMassTons + fixedMassTons) / 2) * 1000;
561.   const avgAcceleration = drive.thrust_N / avgMassKg;
562.   const timeToMidpoint = Math.sqrt((2 * midpointDistance) / avgAcceleration);
563.   const velocityAtMidpoint = avgAcceleration * timeToMidpoint;
564.   const deltaVNeeded = 2 * velocityAtMidpoint;
565. 
566.   let travelDays: number;
567.   if (deltaVNeeded <= actualDeltaVMs) {
568.     travelDays = (timeToMidpoint * 2) / 86400;
569.   } else {
570.     const maxVelocity = actualDeltaVMs / 2;
571.     const accelDistance = (maxVelocity * maxVelocity) / (2 * avgAcceleration);
572.     const coastDistance = targetDistanceM - 2 * accelDistance;
573.     const accelTime = maxVelocity / avgAcceleration;
574.     travelDays = coastDistance > 0 ? (2 * accelTime + coastDistance / maxVelocity) / 86400 : (2 * accelTime) / 86400;
575.   }
576. 
577.   // Material costs
578.   const radiatorResources = radiatorTons / 10;
579.   const radiatorCost =
580.     radiator && needsRadiator
581.       ? {
582.           volatiles: (radiator.weightedBuildMaterials.volatiles || 0) * radiatorResources,
583.           metals: (radiator.weightedBuildMaterials.metals || 0) * radiatorResources,
584.           nobleMetals: (radiator.weightedBuildMaterials.nobleMetals || 0) * radiatorResources,
585.           exotics: (radiator.weightedBuildMaterials.exotics || 0) * radiatorResources,
586.         }
587.       : { volatiles: 0, metals: 0, nobleMetals: 0, exotics: 0 };
588. 
589.   const fuelCost = {
590.     water: drive.propellantMaterials.water * tanksNeeded,
591.     volatiles: drive.propellantMaterials.volatiles * tanksNeeded,
592.     metals: drive.propellantMaterials.metals * tanksNeeded,
593.     nobleMetals: drive.propellantMaterials.nobleMetals * tanksNeeded,
594.     fissiles: drive.propellantMaterials.fissiles * tanksNeeded,
595.     antimatter: drive.propellantMaterials.antimatter * tanksNeeded,
596.   };
597. 
598.   const rc = drive.reactorMaterials || { water: 0, volatiles: 0, metals: 0, nobleMetals: 0 };
599.   const driveRes = (drive.flatMass_tons || 0) / 10;
600.   const driveCost = drive.driveBuildMaterials
601.     ? {
602.         water: (drive.driveBuildMaterials.water || 0) * driveRes,
603.         volatiles: (drive.driveBuildMaterials.volatiles || 0) * driveRes,
604.         metals: (drive.driveBuildMaterials.metals || 0) * driveRes,
605.         exotics: (drive.driveBuildMaterials.exotics || 0) * driveRes,
606.       }
607.     : { water: 0, volatiles: 0, metals: 0, exotics: 0 };
608. 
609.   const totalCost = {
610.     water: (rc.water || 0) + (fuelCost.water || 0) + (driveCost.water || 0),
611.     volatiles:
612.       (rc.volatiles || 0) + (radiatorCost.volatiles || 0) + (fuelCost.volatiles || 0) + (driveCost.volatiles || 0),
613.     metals: (rc.metals || 0) + (radiatorCost.metals || 0) + (fuelCost.metals || 0) + (driveCost.metals || 0),
614.     nobleMetals: (rc.nobleMetals || 0) + (radiatorCost.nobleMetals || 0) + (fuelCost.nobleMetals || 0),
615.     fissiles: fuelCost.fissiles,
616.     antimatter: fuelCost.antimatter,
617.     exotics: (radiatorCost.exotics || 0) + (driveCost.exotics || 0),
618.   };
619. 
620.   const totalCostResources = Object.values(totalCost).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
621.   const hardwareMass = (drive.reactorTons || 0) + radiatorTons + (drive.flatMass_tons || 0);
622.   const totalTons =
623.     params.dryMassTons + (drive.flatMass_tons || 0) + (drive.reactorTons || 0) + radiatorTons + fuelMassTons;
624. 
625.   return {
626.     dataName: drive.dataName,
627.     driveName: drive.friendlyName,
628.     driveEfficiency: drive.efficiency,
629.     reactorEfficiency: drive.reactorEfficiency,
630.     reactorName: drive.reactorName,
631.     reactorTonsPerGW: drive.reactorTonsPerGW,
632.     powerRequiredGW: drive.powerRequiredGW,
633.     wasteHeatGW: drive.wasteHeatGW,
634.     radiatorName: needsRadiator && radiator ? radiator.friendlyName : undefined,
635.     radiatorGWperTon: needsRadiator && radiator ? radiator.gwPerTon : undefined,
636.     tanks: tanksNeeded,
637.     hardwareMass,
638.     totalTons,
639.     driveMassTons: drive.flatMass_tons || 0,
640.     fuelMassTons,
641.     reactorMassTons: drive.reactorTons || 0,
642.     radiatorMassTons: radiatorTons,
643.     driveCost,
644.     fuelCost,
645.     reactorCost: rc,
646.     radiatorCost,
647.     totalCost,
648.     totalCostResources,
649.     deltaV: actualDeltaVKps,
650.     acceleration: accelerationMilliGs,
651.     travelDays,
652.     isUnlocked: false, // filled below
653.   };
654. }
655. 
656. function DriveCalculator({ analysis }: { analysis: Analysis }) {
657.   const bestUnlockedRadiator = analysis.radiators
658.     .filter((r) => r.isUnlocked)
659.     .reduce((best, r) => (!best || r.gwPerTon > best.gwPerTon ? r : best), null as Analysis["radiators"][0] | null);
660. 
661.   const [dryMassInput, setDryMassInput] = useState("10000");
662.   const [radiatorDataName, setRadiatorDataName] = useState(bestUnlockedRadiator?.dataName ?? "");
663.   const [targetDeltaVInput, setTargetDeltaVInput] = useState("250");
664.   const [targetDistanceInput, setTargetDistanceInput] = useState("5");
665.   const [params, setParams] = useState<CalcParams>({
666.     dryMassTons: 10000,
667.     radiatorDataName: bestUnlockedRadiator?.dataName ?? "",
668.     targetDeltaVKps: 250,
669.     targetDistanceAU: 5,
670.   });
671.   const [calcSortColumn, setCalcSortColumn] = useState<CalcSortColumn>("driveName");
672.   const [calcSortDirection, setCalcSortDirection] = useState<"asc" | "desc">("asc");
673. 
674.   const unlockedProjectNames = new Set(analysis.playerFaction.finishedProjectNames);
675. 
676.   const handleUpdate = () => {
677.     const dryMass = parseFloat(dryMassInput);
678.     const targetDV = parseFloat(targetDeltaVInput);
679.     const targetDist = parseFloat(targetDistanceInput);
680.     if (!isNaN(dryMass) && !isNaN(targetDV) && !isNaN(targetDist)) {
681.       setParams({ dryMassTons: dryMass, radiatorDataName, targetDeltaVKps: targetDV, targetDistanceAU: targetDist });
682.     }
683.   };
684. 
685.   const selectedRadiator = useMemo(
686.     () => analysis.radiators.find((r) => r.dataName === params.radiatorDataName),
687.     [analysis.radiators, params.radiatorDataName],
688.   );
689. 
690.   const rows = useMemo(() => {
691.     return analysis.drives
692.       .map((drive) => {
693.         const row = computeCalcRow(drive, selectedRadiator, params);
694.         if (!row) return null;
695.         return { ...row, isUnlocked: unlockedProjectNames.has(drive.requiredProjectName) };
696.       })
697.       .filter((r): r is NonNullable<typeof r> => r !== null);
698.     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
699.   }, [analysis.drives, params, selectedRadiator]);
700.
```

```
1. import { SaveFile } from "../savefile";
2. 
3. export interface AnalyzeNationsArgs {
4.   playerFactionId: number;
5. }
6. 
7. export function analyzeNations(saveFile: SaveFile, { playerFactionId }: AnalyzeNationsArgs) {
8.   // Load control points early so we can use them in faction processing
9.   const controlPoints = saveFile.gamestates["PavonisInteractive.TerraInvicta.TIControlPoint"].map(({ Value: cp }) => ({
10.     id: cp.ID.value,
11.     factionId: cp.faction?.value,
12.     nationId: cp.nation?.value,
13.     displayName: cp.displayName,
14.     benefitsDisabled: cp.benefitsDisabled,
15.     crackdownExpiration: cp.crackdownExpiration,
16.     defended: cp.defended,
17.     controlPointPriorities: cp.controlPointPriorities,
18.   }));
19. 
20.   const regions = saveFile.gamestates["PavonisInteractive.TerraInvicta.TIRegionState"].map(({ Value: region }) => ({
21.     id: region.ID.value,
22.     templateName: region.templateName,
23.     nationId: region.nation.value,
24.     boostPerYear: region.boostPerYear_dekatons,
25.     missionControl: region.missionControl,
26.     populationInMillions: region.populationInMillions,
27.   }));
28.   const regionsById = new Map<number, (typeof regions)[0]>(regions.map((region) => [region.id, region]));
29.   const regionsByNationId = regions.reduce((acc, region) => {
30.     if (!region.nationId) return acc;
31.     if (!acc.has(region.nationId)) {
32.       acc.set(region.nationId, []);
33.     }
34.     acc.get(region.nationId)!.push(region);
35.     return acc;
36.   }, new Map<number, typeof regions>());
37. 
38.   const controlPointsByNationId = controlPoints.reduce((acc, cp) => {
39.     if (!cp.nationId) return acc;
40.     if (!acc.has(cp.nationId)) {
41.       acc.set(cp.nationId, []);
42.     }
43.     acc.get(cp.nationId)!.push(cp);
44.     return acc;
45.   }, new Map<number, typeof controlPoints>());
46.   const nations = saveFile.gamestates["PavonisInteractive.TerraInvicta.TINationState"]
47.     .filter((i) => i.Value.exists && !!i.Value.capital)
48.     .map(({ Value: nation }) => {
49.       const investmentPoints = nation.baseInvestmentPoints_month;
50.       const valuePerSpoilsIP =
51.         5 * investmentPoints +
52.         5 * nation.numMiningRegions_dailyCache +
53.         5 * nation.numOilRegions_dailyCache +
54.         2.5 * (10 - nation.democracy);
55.       const totalSpoils = valuePerSpoilsIP * investmentPoints;
56.       const cpCount = nation.controlPoints.length;
57.       const totalCpCost = Math.pow(nation.GDP / 1000000000, 0.6) / 2; // https://www.reddit.com/r/TerraInvicta/comments/1c9t3c2/control_point_cost_formula/
58.       const totalSpoilsPerCpCost = totalCpCost > 0 ? totalSpoils / totalCpCost : 0;
59.       const totalSpoilsPerControlPoint = cpCount > 0 ? totalSpoils / cpCount : 0;
60.       const controlPoints = controlPointsByNationId.get(nation.ID.value) || [];
61.       const regions = regionsByNationId.get(nation.ID.value) || [];
62.       const mc = regions.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.missionControl, 0);
63.       const boostPerMonth = regions.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.boostPerYear, 0) / 12;
64.       const ipPerCpCost = totalCpCost > 0 ? investmentPoints / totalCpCost : 0;
65.       const possibleBoostPerCpCost = boostPerMonth > 0 ? ipPerCpCost : 0;
66.       const mcPerCpCost = totalCpCost > 0 ? mc / totalCpCost : 0;
67.       const boostPerMonthPerCpCost = totalCpCost > 0 ? boostPerMonth / totalCpCost : 0;
68.       const populationInMillions = regions.reduce((acc, r) => acc + r.populationInMillions, 0);
69.       // allocate priorities like they work in game - as % within CP, then averaged across CPs
70.       const allocatedPriorities = controlPoints
71.         .map((cp) => {
72.           const priorities = cp.controlPointPriorities;
73.           const totalPriorities = Object.values(priorities).reduce((acc, val) => acc + val, 0);
74.           const entries = Object.entries(priorities) as [keyof typeof priorities, number][];
75.           return Object.fromEntries(
76.             entries.map(([key, val]) => [key, totalPriorities > 0 ? val / totalPriorities / controlPoints.length : 0]),
77.           ) as typeof priorities;
78.         })
79.         .reduce(
80.           (acc, pri) => {
81.             (Object.keys(pri) as (keyof typeof pri)[]).forEach((key) => {
82.               acc[key] = (acc[key] || 0) + pri[key];
83.             });
84.             return acc;
85.           },
86.           {} as Record<keyof (typeof controlPoints)[0]["controlPointPriorities"], number>,
87.         );
88. 
89.       const wastedOppression = allocatedPriorities.Oppression > 0 && nation.unrest <= 0.01; // oppression not really needed with no unrest
90.       const tooHighUnrest = nation.unrest > 2 && (allocatedPriorities.Oppression || 0) < 0.5; // unrest high enough to start losing IP and not doing anything about it
91.       const spoilsWithoutAllCPs =
92.         allocatedPriorities.Spoils > 0 &&
93.         controlPoints.some((cp) => cp.benefitsDisabled || cp.factionId !== playerFactionId); // spoils but not all CPs controlled by player
94.       const couldBuildBoost = allocatedPriorities.Spoils > 0 && boostPerMonth > 0; // spoils when we could be building boost
95. 
96.       return {
97.         id: nation.ID.value,
98.         templateName: nation.templateName,
99.         displayName: nation.displayName,
100.         cpCount,
101.         totalCpCost,
102.         valuePerSpoilsIP,
103.         totalSpoils,
104.         totalSpoilsPerCpCost,
105.         totalSpoilsPerControlPoint,
106.         controlPoints,
107.         investmentPoints,
108.         unrest: nation.unrest,
109.         democracy: nation.democracy,
110.         GDP: nation.GDP,
111.         mc,
112.         mcPerCpCost,
113.         boostPerMonth,
114.         boostPerMonthPerCpCost,
115.         populationInMillions,
116.         allocatedPriorities,
117.         wastedOppression,
118.         tooHighUnrest,
119.         spoilsWithoutAllCPs,
120.         couldBuildBoost,
121.         ipPerCpCost,
122.         possibleBoostPerCpCost,
123.       };
124.     })
125.     .filter((i) => i.populationInMillions > 0);
126.   const nationsById = new Map<number, (typeof nations)[0]>(nations.map((nation) => [nation.id, nation]));
127. 
128.   // Add nation history to factions - aggregate all nations where faction has CPs
129.   const allNationStates = saveFile.gamestates["PavonisInteractive.TerraInvicta.TINationState"]
130.     .filter((i) => i.Value.exists && !!i.Value.capital)
131.     .map((i) => i.Value);
132. 
133.   return { nations, nationsById, regions, regionsById, controlPoints, controlPointsByNationId, allNationStates };
134. }
```

```
1. import { readFile, writeFile } from "fs/promises";
2. import { join } from "path";
3. import { gunzipSync } from "zlib";
4. import type { MissionDataName, TraitDataName, CouncilorTypeDataName, HabSchematicDataName } from "./templates";
5. 
6. export async function loadSaveFile(filePath: string): Promise<SaveFile> {
7.   const start = Date.now();
8. 
9.   const buffer = await readFile(filePath);
10.   console.log(`Loaded save file in ${Date.now() - start}ms`);
11. 
12.   const decompressed = gunzipSync(buffer);
13.   let content = decompressed.toString("utf8");
14.   console.log(`Loaded and decompressed save file in ${Date.now() - start}ms`);
15. 
16.   // for some reason, there's an extra character at the start of the file - charcode 65279
17.   // once we strip that, JSON.parse works fine and is _much_ faster than JSON5.parse().
18.   while (content[0] !== "{" && content.length > 0) {
19.     content = content.substring(1);
20.   }
21. 
22.   // this file can also contain +/-Infinity values (though maybe that's caused by 0.4.90 -> RC25 migration), which we need to fix:
23.   content = content.replace(/": -Infinity/g, '": -1e+300');
24.   content = content.replace(/": Infinity/g, '": 1e+300');
25. 
26.   try {
27.     const rawData = JSON.parse(content);
28.     console.log(`Loaded, decompressed, and parsed save file in ${Date.now() - start}ms`);
29. 
30.     // some data is shared via $id and $ref, we need to resolve those references - common for arrivalTime for fleet trajectories
31.     const sharedItems = findSharedItems(rawData);
32.     return fixReferences<SaveFile>(rawData, sharedItems);
33.   } catch (e) {
34.     console.error(`Error parsing JSON from file ${filePath}:`, e);
35. 
36.     const dumpJsonError = process.env.DUMP_JSON_ERROR;
37.     if (dumpJsonError) {
38.       // Write cleaned content to temp file for inspection
39.       const debugFile = join(process.cwd(), dumpJsonError);
40.       await writeFile(debugFile, content, "utf8");
41.       console.error(`\nCleaned content written to: ${debugFile}`);
42.     }
43. 
44.     throw e;
45.   }
46. }
47. 
48. function findSharedItems(obj: any, sharedItems: Map<string, any> = new Map()): Map<string, any> {
49.   if (!obj) return sharedItems;
50.   if (typeof obj === "object") {
51.     if (obj["$id"]) {
52.       sharedItems.set(obj["$id"], obj);
53.     }
54.     for (const key in obj) {
55.       const value = obj[key];
56.       findSharedItems(value, sharedItems);
57.     }
58.   } else if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
59.     obj.forEach((item) => findSharedItems(item, sharedItems));
60.   }
```

```
64. function fixReferences<T>(obj: any, sharedItems: Map<string, any>): T {
65.   if (!obj) return obj;
66.   if (typeof obj === "object") {
67.     if (obj["$ref"]) {
68.       return sharedItems.get(obj["$ref"]);
69.     }
70.     for (const key in obj) {

72.       const newValue = fixReferences(value, sharedItems);

74.         obj[key] = newValue;
75.       }
76.     }
77.   } else if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
78.     for (var i = 0; i < obj.length; i++) {
79.       const value = obj[i];

81.       if (newValue !== value) {
```

```
55.   let day = a.day - b.day;
56.   let month = a.month - b.month;
57.   let year = a.year - b.year;
58.   if (millisecond < 0) {
59.     millisecond += 1000;
60.     second -= 1;
61.   }

64.     minute -= 1;
65.   }

68.     hour -= 1;
69.   }

72.     day -= 1;
73.   }

75.     // Assuming 30 days in a month for simplicity
76.     day += 30;
77.     month -= 1;
78.   }
79.   if (month < 0) {
80.     month += 12;
81.     year -= 1;
82.   }
83.

100.     2,
101.     "0",
102.   )}:${String(dt.minute).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(dt.second).padStart(2, "0")}.${String(dt.millisecond).padStart(
103.     3,

105.   )}`;

109. export function smartRound(value: number): string {
110.   // Handle very small numbers with SI prefixes (below 0.001)
111.   if (value !== 0 && Math.abs(value) < 1e-3) {
112.     const absValue = Math.abs(value);
113.     const sign = value < 0 ? "-" : "";
114. 
115.     // SI prefixes for small numbers (descending order)
116.     const prefixes = [
117.       { threshold: 1e-6, symbol: "μ", divisor: 1e-6 }, // micro
118.       { threshold: 1e-9, symbol: "n", divisor: 1e-9 }, // nano
119.       { threshold: 1e-12, symbol: "p", divisor: 1e-12 }, // pico
120.       { threshold: 1e-15, symbol: "f", divisor: 1e-15 }, // femto
121.       { threshold: 1e-18, symbol: "a", divisor: 1e-18 }, // atto
122.     ];
123. 
124.     for (const { threshold, symbol, divisor } of prefixes) {
125.       if (absValue >= threshold) {
126.         const scaled = absValue / divisor;
127.         // Use 3 significant figures, but avoid trailing zeros after decimal
128.         const digits = scaled >= 100 ? 0 : scaled >= 10 ? 1 : 2;
129.         const formatted = scaled.toFixed(digits);
130.         const trimmed = formatted.includes(".") ? formatted.replace(/\.?0+$/, "") : formatted;
131.         return `${sign}${trimmed}${symbol}`;
132.       }
133.     }
134.   }
135. 
136.   // Original logic for normal-sized numbers
137.   const digits = value === 0 || Math.round(value) === value ? 0 : Math.max(0, 3 - Math.log10(Math.abs(value)));
138.   const formatted = value.toFixed(digits);
139.   // Only remove trailing zeros if there's a decimal point
140.   return formatted.includes(".") ? formatted.replace(/\.?0+$/, "") : formatted;
141. }

144.   // For values >= 100, show no decimals
145.   if (value >= 100) {
146.     return `${value.toFixed(0)}%`;
147.   }
148.   // For values < 100, show one decimal place
149.   return `${value.toFixed(1)}%`;
150. }

159.     antimatter: ((a?.antimatter || 0) + (b?.antimatter || 0)) * multiplier,
```

```
177. export function analyzeNationClaims({
178.   allNationStates,
179.   nationsById,
180.   regionsById,
181.   controlPointsByNationId,
182.   playerNationIds,
183.   playerFactionId,
184.   factionsById,

186. }: AnalyzeNationClaimsArgs): NationClaimsEntry[] {
187.   const nationStateById = new Map(allNationStates.map((n) => [n.ID.value, n]));
188. 
189.   const playerNationIdSet = new Set(playerNationIds);
190. 
191.   const result: NationClaimsEntry[] = [];
192. 
193.   for (const nationId of playerNationIdSet) {
194.     const nationState = nationStateById.get(nationId);
195.     const nation = nationsById.get(nationId);
196.     if (!nationState || !nation) continue;
197. 
198.     // Map claims (region IDs) to target nation IDs (excluding self-claims)
199.     const targetNationIds = new Set<number>();
200.     for (const claimRef of nationState.claims) {
201.       const region = regionsById.get(claimRef.value);
202.       if (region && region.nationId && region.nationId !== nationId) {
203.         targetNationIds.add(region.nationId);
204.       }
205.     }
206. 
207.     if (targetNationIds.size === 0) continue;
208. 
209.     // Build cooldown lookups for this nation
210.     const improveCooldowns = new Map<number, DateTime>(
211.       (nationState.improveRelationsCooldowns || []).map((kv) => [kv.Key.value, kv.Value]),
212.     );
213.     const rivalryCooldowns = new Map<number, DateTime>(
214.       (nationState.rivalryCooldowns || []).map((kv) => [kv.Key.value, kv.Value]),
215.     );
216. 
217.     const targets: NationClaimTarget[] = [];
218. 
219.     for (const targetId of targetNationIds) {
220.       const targetNation = nationsById.get(targetId);
221.       const targetState = nationStateById.get(targetId);
222.       if (!targetNation || !targetState) continue;
223. 
224.       // Determine relationship
225.       let relationship: NationRelationship = "neutral";
226.       if (
227.         nationState.federation &&
228.         targetState.federation &&
229.         nationState.federation.value === targetState.federation.value
230.       ) {
231.         relationship = "federation";
232.       } else if (nationState.allies.some((a) => a.value === targetId)) {
233.         relationship = "ally";
234.       } else if (nationState.rivals.some((r) => r.value === targetId)) {
235.         relationship = "rival";
236.       }
237. 
238.       // Cooldown dates (only show if in the future)
239.       const improveDate = improveCooldowns.get(targetId);
240.       const rivalryDate = rivalryCooldowns.get(targetId);
241.       const relationsCanImproveAfter =
242.         improveDate && isDateInFuture(improveDate, gameCurrentDateTime) ? formatDateShort(improveDate) : null;
243.       const warActionAfter =
244.         rivalryDate && isDateInFuture(rivalryDate, gameCurrentDateTime) ? formatDateShort(rivalryDate) : null;
245. 
246.       // Executive CP faction in target nation
247.       const targetCPs = controlPointsByNationId.get(targetId) || [];
248.       const executiveCP = targetCPs.find((cp) => cp.controlPointType === "Executive");
249.       const execFaction = executiveCP?.factionId ? factionsById.get(executiveCP.factionId) : null;

254.         relationship,

257.         executiveFactionId: execFaction?.id ?? null,
258.         executiveFactionName: execFaction?.displayName ?? null,
259.         executiveFactionTemplateName: execFaction?.templateName ?? null,
260.       });
261.     }
262. 
263.     // Sort targets by relationship priority then name
264.     const relationOrder: Record<NationRelationship, number> = { federation: 0, ally: 1, neutral: 2, rival: 3 };
```
